_documentation: Lender configurations for the quoting calculator. Each lender has a unique commission model.

lenders.name: Westpac / Metro Finance
lenders.description: Commission is added to loan principal. Customer pays interest on commission.

formula.PMT: standard compound interest on total_financed at base_rate
formula.comparison_rate: rate on NAF that produces same PMT

notes: Comparison rate is always higher than base rate due to capitalised commission
Supports both advance and arrears payment modes
Balloon payments reduce monthly PMT but increase comparison rate

lenders.name: Branded Financial Services
lenders.description: Broker earns MAX(base commission, 75% + GST of rate dial-up difference).
notes: Contract rate must be >= base rate
No commission added to principal - customer rate = contract rate
Monthly fee of $8 is charged separately (not in PMT calculation)
Broker can target a specific commission and reverse-calculate required rate

lenders.name: Pepper Money
lenders.description: Uses a unique loading formula that partially capitalises commission.

commission.calculation: NAF × commission_rate, with 0.4 loading factor applied

formula.customer_rate: rate on NAF that produces this PMT

notes: The 0.4 factor is unique to Pepper - reverse-engineered from their portal
Only ~93% of commission impacts the PMT at typical rates
Customer rate is between financier rate and what capitalised rate would be
Fees can be individually set as financed or upfront

lenders.name: MoneyMe / Autopay
lenders.description: Daily interest calculation with monthly payments. Capitalised commission.

establishment.note: Included in starting principal provided by lender

commission.note: Commission already included in starting principal from lender

formula.payment_date_adjustment: if weekend or NSW public holiday, move to next business day

notes: First payment has +1 day interest (settlement day counts)
Payment dates adjusted to next business day if falls on weekend/holiday
Uses NSW public holidays (lender is in Sydney)
Target payment day is maintained month-to-month where possible
Daily interest means each payment period has variable interest based on actual days

capitalised_vs_overs.capitalised: Customer pays interest on commission → higher comparison rate
capitalised_vs_overs.overs: Customer doesn't pay interest on commission → commission from rate markup

daily_vs_monthly.daily: Interest = balance × (rate/365) × actual_days → varies each period

advance_vs_arrears.advance: First payment at settlement, PMT = standard_PMT / (1 + monthly_rate)
advance_vs_arrears.arrears: First payment after one period, PMT = standard compound interest formula
